headline: Rashi Peripherals Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - The Board of Directors of the Company ("the Board") at their Meeting held today has approved the proposal for raising of funds for an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs. 900 Crores, as per the details attached herewith.
